name: HOI4D
summary: 四维人-物交互视频数据集，包含手部、物体和相机运动标注。
summaryEn: A 4D human-object interaction video dataset with hand, object, and camera-motion annotations.
wmNote: 适合接触动力学和动作后果。
wmNoteEn: Supports contact dynamics and action outcomes.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2203.01577] HOI4D: A 4D Egocentric Dataset for Category-Level Human-Object Interaction
evidence.statement: RGB-D interaction sequences include frame-wise hand and object poses and motion segmentation, directly exposing temporal object evolution.
